verdict.rationale: The docs describe integrating the crypto products into a Stripe integration: enabling the Crypto payment method, embedded and SDK onramps, and stablecoin payments over the x402 machine-payments protocol. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages), an official MCP server and an official CLI also support programmatic, agent-friendly access. However, no crypto-specific API reference or endpoints are cited, the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path, and some flows are dashboard-driven, such as wallet linking in the Express Dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit API reference for the crypto/stablecoin endpoints, a reachable OpenAPI spec, API coverage for preview and dashboard-only features, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
